description:
Use this when the user asks how much of an Indian company's promoter holding is pledged and how that has changed.

Returns, for each quarter, newest first, the percentage of the promoters' own shares that are pledged or otherwise encumbered, the same shares as a percentage of all shares, their number and the promoters' holding, with the latest figure and its change from the quarter before. `limit` is 1 to 16 (default 12). `pledge_disclosed` is false where the filing gave no pledge figure, which is not the same as zero. For the full ownership breakdown use get_shareholding.

query.description: One company: NSE symbol, ISIN or BSE code, e.g. TCS, INE467B01029 or 532540. Always send it as `query` (not `symbol`).
query.title: Query

name: get_pledge_trend
title: Promoter pledge trend
